description: Alterations and refurbishment of restaurant interior, including addition of two fireplaces and a pizza oven. Internal works at ground floor including: removal of plaster finish to column and pilasters and reinstatement of brickwork beneath; retention and redecoration of plaster capitals, architraves and keystone; removal of paint and wallpaper to brickwork and reinstatement of brickwork beneath; replacement of light fittings, replacement of plasterboard ceiling with V-grooved, painted timber ceiling at same height; refurbishment of cornices; replacement of diffusers and air handling units with discreet system at perimeter of ceiling; replacement of bar with dispense bar centred between arches; removal of staircase balustrade and handrail; replacement of marble cladding to stairs with oak to match floor and handrails; removal of decorative panels and steelwork in end bay, repainting of wall; removal of section of wall between kitchen and restaurant [previously a doorway] for placement of lobster tank;  removal of modern partition walls and mirror finishes between columns separating kitchen and restaurant; removal of kitchen equipment and floor tiles; refitting of kitchen and replacement of tiles with Victorian tiles; installation of pizza oven; removal of sanitary ware, WC joinery and floor tiles; refitting of WC. Internal works at first floor including: removal of wallpaper, wall refurbishment, replacement of paint to brickwork around arched windows with a breathable paint finish; removal of mottled film on glazing; replacement of balustrades in mezzanine to Victorian style timber profiles with glazing; installation of two gas fireplaces; installation of banquette joinery seating; replacement of plasterboard ceiling with V-grooved, painted timber ceiling; replacement of diffusers and air handling units with discreet system at perimeter of ceiling; introduction of dispense bar to serve first floor areas.
